en.title: EIP-8038 and EIP-7928: the pre-state gas of contract creation is left open
en.summary: The pre-state validation table of EIP-7928 lists costs in addition to the base cost of the instruction and uses the older gas constant for contract creation. EIP-8038 replaces that constant with an access charge, which is also the base cost, plus a separate state gas charge, and its section on EIP-7928 does not mention the table. Read together, the two leave the pre-state amount open: a reader can add the access charge twice, or can add the state gas charge. The execution specification charges the access charge once, together with memory expansion and the init code cost. In pull request 12418, closed in October 2026, an author of EIP-7928 wrote that it would not depend on EIP-8038, so the mapping belongs in EIP-8038.
en.impact: Contract creation under both EIPs: by one reading the access charge is counted twice, by another the state gas charge is added, while the execution specification counts the access charge once. Coding agents wrote correct code from the current text, and all three runs asked about this table. With an earlier draft of the proposed paragraph, one of three still did.
en.correction: Add a paragraph to the section of EIP-8038 on EIP-7928 that maps the names in the table to the constants of EIP-8038: the access charge is counted once, the extra warm access of the two code-reading instructions is part of pre-state validation, and state gas is not. Proposed in pull request 12612.
